proposed_widenings.name: conjured_spirit_zone
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell places a persistent entity (spirit) at a location that independently opens save-gate windows when creatures enter or start turns nearby. No existing family models a concentration-duration, location-bound entity that acts as an autonomous trigger source. 'anchored_trigger' is the nearest family but its output pipe ends at AnchoredSignal (audible/mental notifications), not combat effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You conjure a Large, intangible spirit from the Elemental Planes that appears in an unoccupied space within range... Whenever a creature you can see enters the spirit's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw if the spirit has no creature Restrained.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: "restrained"
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type is closed at 'prone'. Conjure Elemental applies the Restrained condition, which is mechanically distinct from Prone and required for the repeat-save guard ('if the spirit has no creature Restrained').
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has the Restrained condition until the spell ends... Whenever a creature... you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw if the spirit has no creature Restrained.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect: apply_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The Effect union is DamageEffect | NoneEffect. Conjure Elemental's on-fail branch applies a condition (Restrained) in addition to dealing damage. apply_condition is in the v4 atom inventory but not surfaced in the Effect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On failed save, the target takes 8d8 damage of the spirit's type, and the target has the Restrained condition until the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect: remove_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-success branch of the repeat save removes the Restrained condition. remove_condition is in the v4 atom inventory but not in the Effect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful save, the target isn't Restrained by the spirit.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase: repeat_save
proposed_widenings.justification: The Restrained target repeats the DEX save at the start of each of its turns — a repeat_save phase. This resolution atom is in v4 but has no corresponding ActivationPhase variant in types.ts. The existing phase variants are attack_roll and save_gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target repeats the save. On a failed save, the target takes 4d8 damage of the spirit's type. On a successful save, the target isn't Restrained by the spirit.

proposed_widenings.name: trigger guard: condition_occupancy_check
proposed_widenings.justification: The save is only available when the spirit currently has zero Restrained creatures. This is a conditional trigger guard keyed on runtime condition state of attached targets. No existing surface shape models a trigger that is gated on whether any attached target currently holds a specific condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw if the spirit has no creature Restrained

notes: The damage-type choice (air=Lightning, earth=Thunder, fire=Fire, water=Cold) is a cast-time parameter selection, not a widening issue per se — the DamageType union already covers all four. The slot-scaling (+1d8/slot above 5) would use the existing linear_per_level shape once the broader structural issues are resolved. The conjured-spirit family is the primary blocker: the spell is fundamentally a stationary zone entity with a combat-effect pipeline, not a stored-signal trigger. Even if all the condition/repeat-save variants were added to the existing activation family, there is no surface shape for 'the spirit lives at a location and independently triggers per-creature per-turn'.
